title: Visitor statistics
changes: Google Analytics records which pages are visited, so the team can see which testimonies people actually watch.
Page views are sent on every navigation, not only the first — without that, a single-page app reports almost nothing about where visitors go.

Ad personalisation and cross-device identity are switched off: these pages are named survivors testimonies read by visitors who have no account, and counts answer the question without building profiles.
Nothing is recorded while running the app locally, so development traffic stays out of the reports.
